items.name: settings-form
items.title: Settings form
items.description: Route page: Form with Field, Combobox, OtpField and Switch. Validates on submit, moves focus to an error summary on failure, shows a submitting state and a success Toast. Copy the page to app/routes/settings-form.tsx in a react-router app and install the listed items first.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with Square Enix or PlatinumGames. Inspired by the YoRHa UI aesthetic; no original fonts, logos or assets are included. The save request is a timer stand-in: replace it with your action.
